- 2021-01-08 (Friday)

`=SUMIFS(B:B,A:A,">="&WORKDAY(I4,-4),A:A,"<"&I4)`

- WORKDAY(2021-01-11, -1) = 2021-01-08 (Friday)

- WORKDAY(2021-01-11, -3) = 2021-01-06 (Wednesday)
- WORKDAY(2021-01-11, -4) = 2021-01-05 (Tuesday)

So WORKDAY(I4, -4) gives us 2021-01-05. Then we want to sum dates >= 2021-01-05 and < 2021-01-11, which gives us the 4 days: Jan 5, 6, 7, 8.
